staging_note: STAGED DESIGN COPY, not wired. Olesm's pool is shipped; chatted_with_olesm accrues today.

lines: Oh — you! No no, the tally can wait. The tally is wrong anyway; it will still be wrong in an hour.
I put your cistern business in my report. With your name spelled correctly and everything. In this office that is practically a parade.
I've started leaving the second chair out. Statistically you keep existing near my desk, so — efficiency.
I set the board up when the bells go quiet now, on the chance you wander past. That isn't pathetic, that's PREPARED.
Erin beat me in eleven moves yesterday. Eleven! I wrote them all down. I'm going to frame the humiliation and study it daily.
You, me, the board, one hour. I've been saving an opening that is either brilliant or a resignation with extra steps.

hub_options.text: You run half this city from that desk. You know that, right?

hub_options._flag: CANON ⚑ mild — [Strategist] ambition is safe early canon; the letters beat is a proto-newsletter nod kept oblique (never says 'newsletter').

olesm_doubt.speaker: Olesm
olesm_doubt.text: Ha. HA. No. I run the paperwork the Council ignores, and I'm a [Tactician] whose largest engagement to date was a supply-cart dispute. ...Which I won. Decisively. I keep a list of what I'd do if Liscor were ever truly tested. It's a good list. I would just rather die of old age never having to show anyone.

options.text: I hope the list stays theoretical.
The cart never stood a chance.

olesm_doubt_two.speaker: Olesm
olesm_doubt_two.text: So do I. That's the strange arithmetic of the job — you train your whole life for a day you pray never comes, and the better you are, the more boring the city stays. Liscor is very boring. I'm quietly proud of that.

olesm_ambition.speaker: Olesm
olesm_ambition.text: Honestly? There's a class above mine. [Strategist]. Cities write to theirs. Armies wait on them. Some nights I can almost see the shape of the level — like a move you know is on the board and cannot find yet. ...I've started writing to other [Tacticians]. Comparing games, doctrine, mistakes. Perhaps it becomes nothing. Perhaps it becomes something every city wants a copy of.

olesm_ambition_two.speaker: Olesm
olesm_ambition_two.text: You'd be the second subscriber. The first is me, checking for errors. ...Thank you. People ask what I do; you asked what I'm FOR. There's a difference, and it's most of why the second chair stays out.

perk.summary: ⚑ The chess counter-beat (spec default): an authored match scene — he replays Erin's eleven-move win against you and makes you find the counter. Suggested backing: a stage-gated hub option ('Set the board.') → a short authored match node chain banking chess_with_olesm (NEW counter) + a 2g friendly wager either way (dialogue gold effects exist).
